branch.description: The local branch the commits are on.

base.description: The branch the work is based on, normally the default branch.

committed.description: True when the change is committed and ready for the factory to publish. If false, the reason is in known_limitations.

head_commit.description: The output of git rev-parse HEAD after the last commit, or null when nothing was committed.

change.description: What changed in this file and why.

verification.description: Every check that ran, exactly as run, with its result.

result.description: Pass or fail, and the relevant output.

deviations.description: Departures from the plan, with reasons. Empty when the plan held.

known_limitations.description: Anything the reviewer should look at closely.
